user.title: Connect to your Freebox
user.description: Leave the defaults if your Freebox is reachable at its usual address. The port is the HTTPS port advertised by the box.

data_description.host: Use the name advertised by the box (for example `xxxxxxxx.fbxos.fr` or `mafreebox.freebox.fr`), not an IP address: the certificate would not match.

link.title: Authorize Home Assistant
link.description:
Go to your {name} and get ready to press the right arrow, then **✓**, on its screen.

When you submit this form, the box will display an authorization request for Home Assistant. You have about three minutes to accept it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Home Assistant
reauth_confirm.description: The authorization stored for {name} is no longer valid. Get ready to accept a new request on the box's screen, then submit.

progress.wait_for_validation: Accept the authorization request on the screen of your {name}: press the right arrow then **✓**.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Freebox. Check the address and port, and that you are on the local network.
error.invalid_auth: The Freebox rejected the authorization request.
error.authorization_denied: The request was refused or timed out on the box. Try again and accept it on the screen.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.unsupported_api_version: This Freebox exposes an API version that is too old for this integration.
abort.https_not_available: HTTPS is not enabled on this Freebox; the API cannot be used securely.
abort.wrong_box: That address belongs to a different Freebox.

init.title: Data categories
init.description: Pick what to poll. Optional categories need their permission enabled by hand in Freebox OS: Settings > Access management > Applications.

data_description.consider_home: Seconds during which a device that stopped answering is still reported as home.

intervals.title: Refresh intervals
intervals.description: Seconds between two polls. Lower values mean more load on the box.

missing_permission.title: Missing Freebox permission
missing_permission.description:
The `{category}` category needs the `{permission}` permission, which is not granted to Home Assistant.

Open Freebox OS > Settings > Access management > Applications, edit **Home Assistant (Freebox Ultra)**, enable the permission, then reload the integration.
